newsitem.title: JAPAN: Money supply moving in line with expectations -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Money supply moving in line with expectations -- BOJ.

text.p: Japan's money supply is moving in line with the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) expectations, a BOJ official told reporters on Monday.
The central bank earlier announced that Japan's broadly defined money supply average of M2 plus certificates of deposit grew a preliminary 3.0 percent in July from a year earlier.
"Money supply is moving in line with the BOJ's expectations of a growth of about three precent in the July-September quarter," the official said.

Asked how the economic situation was reflected in the money supply supply data, the official said it was difficult to assess the current economic situation from looking at money supply growth alone. He said the July data could not be taken to confirm a pessimistic view on the future of the economy in financial markets.
